participants.note: ACKed, noted improvement in functional code dedicated to logging and utility of LogWarnThenDebug
approved with Approach -0, noting demoting warnings/errors removes useful tags but acceptable to merge
ACKed after clarifying distinction between Debug and LogWarnThenDebug
Concept ACK and later lightly tested ACK; offered suggestions on tests, macro formatting, and messages
asked author if they planned to address remaining comments

claims.harm: demoting socks5 proxy communication errors may hide problems from users and make diagnosing server issues harder
claims.quote: If this is an error communicating with the proxy server... Hiding this could make problems harder to diagnose, and it might be better to keep the previous level
claims.settled_by_quote: Code review ACK 8d60c1428507921d9dd70c9840c41e447649268f. Approach -0... I think the PR may be RFM

claims.harm: LogWarnThenDebug warns only once and may permanently hide intermittent or recurring failures
claims.quote: warning exactly once and never again may hide recurring failures. It would seem better to have a rate limit and show the error once per hour or once per day while it is still occurring
claims.settled_by_quote: Code review ACK 8d60c1428507921d9dd70c9840c41e447649268f. Approach -0... I think the PR may be RFM

claims.harm: dropping error and warning tags makes logs harder to interpret and distinguish failure messages from normal notifications
claims.quote: The thing I don’t like about this change is that it makes it harder to see if messages are errors or warnings or normal notifications. Being able to see [error] and [warning] tags is a nice feature that is unfortunate to lose.
claims.settled_by_quote: Code review ACK 8d60c1428507921d9dd70c9840c41e447649268f. Approach -0... I think the PR may be RFM if review comments are replied to and there aren't other objections.

support.reason: This is a good improvement on the amount of functional code dedicated to logging. Also, the `LogWarnThenDebug` log will be useful in future cases to help avoid log noise
The changes make sense to me
lightly tested ACK; focused on correctness, style, utility, and consistency - the world is a slightly better place after this change
Code review ACK with Approach -0; PR seems fine overall and may be RFM
